title: MacArthur's 1955 West Point interplanetary war speech

tellings.quote: During a 1955 speech at West Point, General MacArthur told assembled cadetses, "The next war will be an interplanetary war.

plain: General Douglas MacArthur, in a 1955 speech at West Point, is said to have told the assembled cadets: "The next war will be an interplanetary war." Michels quotes it himself, without naming a source, in an episode with Harald Malmgren, a former presidential advisor who says he handled UFO material. Michels brings it up as a sign that a top general took the idea of threats from beyond Earth seriously.
